title: Grays that handled Travis Walton were robots built by the Nordics
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Grays that handled Travis Walton were robots built by the Nordics, about 1975 at Arizona, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's one group of grays that literally are robots created by the Nordics. Those are the ones that handle Travis Walton.

plain: Travis Walton is a logging worker who says he was taken aboard a UFO in Arizona in 1975 and handled by small grey beings, often called Grays. On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a writer and philosopher named Jason Jorjani says one group of Grays are really robots built by the Nordics, tall human-looking beings in UFO lore, and that those robots are the ones that handled Walton, which would mean the Grays are not always the ones in charge.
